brief.summary_1line: After hearing of Atikaya’s death, Ravana anxiously reflects on fallen warriors and orders stronger defenses around Lanka and the Ashoka Grove.

image_candidates.scene_text: Ravana sits on his throne in a dark hall of Lanka, surrounded by anxious rakshasa generals as he hears that Atikaya has been slain.
Rakshasa sentinels rush to fortify the gates and walls of Lanka while the distant Ashoka Grove where Sita is guarded lies under heavy watch.
